pictures.name: RAT1-Plowing-Festival
pictures.prompt: A spring festival in ancient India: green fields under a bright sky, white oxen with garlands pulling a decorated golden plow guided by King Suddhodana (a dignified king with a trimmed black beard and gold crown), crowds of townspeople with flags and music along the field’s edge. Warm gold light, deep blue sky. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

Warm gold light beyond, cool deep blue shade under the tree. pictures.prompt: Late afternoon under the rose-apple tree. King Suddhodana kneels and bows before his son, palms together, the nurses behind him astonished. Deep blue shade.
